entries.title: Marketing screenshot and video flow
entries.description: Five privacy-safe product-shell checkpoints plus a 30-second recorded walkthrough that drives the real dashboard, provider terminals, task plan, usage sheet and a new-session draft into its live chat on one fixed-frame interaction clock.
states: One project and four mixed chats

entries.title: Welcome and connection entry
entries.description: The unpaired first-run surface, including the product promise, pairing entry and demo route.

entries.title: Pair a Mac
entries.description: The camera/link pairing flow with secure-link guidance and the complete compact-phone layout.

entries.title: Session dashboard
entries.description: The paired owner dashboard and project-scoped chat list, with host switching in navigation chrome, project-aware session creation, named multi-route connection progress and actionable recovery.
states: Offline recovery with saved routes and identity

entries.title: Chat settings
entries.description: Owner controls for moving a live chat between accounts, continuing it on another agent, choosing its limit-recovery behavior, and opening account usage without returning to the dashboard.

entries.title: Universal search
entries.description: The native owner search surface backed by the Mac's bounded search graph, with visible scope, stable result groups, highlighted literal matches, provenance and honest provider coverage.

entries.title: Standalone terminals
entries.description: The paired owner catalogue for project shells, drawn as rows of the same list as chats and told apart by the terminal mark, before either kind opens its dedicated surface.

entries.title: Session opening states
entries.description: The session screen before it has a live surface: opening an available chat, waking a dormant one on the Mac, and the failure it reports when neither happens.

entries.title: Connection progress
entries.description: The interactive DEBUG host for the shipping dashboard card and navigation status, showing one active transport operation at an authored checkpoint.

entries.title: Connection panel
entries.description: The panel the two-line connection title opens on the chat list, a project's chat list, an open chat and a new-session draft: the way in and address in use, the identity check, the answering request's protocol and timings, every saved way in, and the iPhone's own network and addresses.
states: Connected over Tailscale on Wi-Fi with a cellular context up

entries.title: Native conversation
entries.description: The real virtualized mobile timeline, composer, structured run-plan disclosure, tool activity and collaboration state under both authored appearances.

entries.title: Representative Mac-supplied chrome matrix
entries.description: The rich native conversation sentinel under every deterministic Mac-supplied theme payload shipped by the mobile evidence fixture.

entries.title: Scoped permission decision
entries.description: A one-shot remote permission card with its bounded edit context and explicit allow/deny actions.

entries.title: Human attention request
entries.description: The explicit collaboration attention sheet that never masquerades as agent input or a prompt submission.

entries.title: Remote terminal
entries.description: The relayed SwiftTerm surface with mobile keyboard controls, viewport ownership and collaboration state.
states: Local scrollback away from live end

entries.title: Git Review
entries.description: The compact owner-only file review surface with real diff rows and stage boundaries.

entries.title: Session workspace
entries.description: The companion workspace route joining Browser, Review, repository files and attachments without toolbar sprawl.

entries.title: Browser follow
entries.description: The read-only Mac browser projection, including the private-tab boundary where pixels intentionally remain on the Mac.

entries.title: Session attachments
entries.description: The bounded attachment inventory with user/agent provenance and representative image, PDF, HTML and unsupported archive kinds.

entries.title: Usage dashboard
entries.description: The owner-only one-page current-capacity, Limit History and Consumption sheet, including positive, authoritative-zero and unavailable banked-reset inventories.

entries.description: One sheet with two stages: the three grants as themed rows, and the one-use invite the chosen grant mints.

entries.description: The shared app-owned alert and bottom confirmation primitives over the real mobile theme boundary.
